A '''latke''' is a potato pancake that heals {{Hp|12}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/latke.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Potato|baked potato]], an egg, [[bread]] (or naan) and a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]]. Obtaining a baked potato unlocks the recipe; crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a latke takes 2 seconds and heals {{Hp|12}}.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Healing reduced from 8 hearts to 6.}}
{{History line|Upcoming|2=Crafting a latke returns the milk bottle's glass bottle. In 1.12.2 the advancement behind this still used an old recipe ID, so the bottle was lost.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>}}
}}
